name: alpen
title_zh: 一个装 11 个瑞士军刀式小技能的合集包
tagline_zh: 不装全家桶，只挑 11 个各管一摊的小工具：从文本清洗到数据转换，每个都能单独拎出来用，不互相绑架。
tagline_en: Not a bloated suite—just 11 independent, single-purpose tools for text cleanup, data wrangling, and more. Each.
why_zh: 每个 skill 都是独立小单元，按需取用不拖泥带水。合集包的好处是：装一次，11 个场景都有备选。
why_en: Each skill is a self-contained unit—grab what you need, skip the rest. One install covers 11 common tasks without hunting for.
limit_zh: 合集不等于万能：只覆盖这 11 个具体场景，超出范围没有兜底。且各 skill 之间不共享上下文。
limit_en: Covers exactly 11 scenarios—no more. Skills don't share context; output from A won't auto-feed into B. For anything else, look elsewhere.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
